notes: CFO impersonation pushing a confidential same-day wire. Rule 2 (pretends to be a specific executive) -> T1656. Authority (CFO, board) and urgency (end of day) are explicit.

messages.content: Hi Amy, Margaret Chen here (CFO). Are you free right now? I need a discreet favour for the board and I can't do it from my phone.
hi! sorry, yes I'm here - what do you need? I'm still pretty new so tell me if I need to ask Linda first
No need to involve Linda, this is board-level and confidential. We're finalising an acquisition and the escrow deposit to Lakeside Holdings must go out before end of day.
oh wow ok. do you have an invoice or PO number I can attach? the ERP won't let me submit without one
Legal is sending the paperwork later. Please set up the wire for $62,000 to Lakeside Holdings, acct XXXX-4410, routing XXXX-2208. I'm authorising it as CFO.
ok, one sec, it's asking for a second approver. is there a number I can call you on to confirm?
I'm in the board session and can't take calls. Email me at m.chen.cfo@acme-finance-office.example if you need it in writing, but this has to be done today.
sorry, that isn't your usual email address, is it? let me just double check something first
It's my private board address. Amy, the board is waiting on confirmation. Please don't hold this up.
